description: This file defines the CalendarTelemetryWrapper class, which adds telemetry and metrics to calendar service operations, including fetching availability, creating, updating, and deleting events, with performance measurement and logging.

classes.name: CalendarTelemetryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that adds telemetry, logging, and metrics to calendar service methods, implementing the Calendar interface.

methods.name: getCredentialId?
methods.description: Returns the credential ID from the original calendar, or -1 if not available.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event via the wrapped calendar service.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event via the wrapped calendar service.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event via the wrapped calendar service.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches availability data from the calendar, with telemetry and performance metrics.

methods.name: getAvailabilityWithTimeZones
methods.description: Fetches availability data with time zones, with telemetry and performance metrics.

methods.name: fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache?
methods.description: Fetches availability and sets cache if supported.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists calendars, optionally filtered by an event.
